t: 元和天子神武姿，彼何人哉軒與羲。
c: 元和天子神武姿，彼何人哉轩与羲。
p: Yuán hé tiān zǐ shén wǔ zī bǐ hé rén zāi xuān yǔ xī

en: The Emperor of the Yuanhe era possesses a divine and martial bearing; who is he if not the Yellow Emperor or Fuxi?

t: 誓將上雪列聖恥，坐法宮中朝四夷。
c: 誓将上雪列圣耻，坐法宫中朝四夷。
p: Shì jiāng shàng xuě liè shèng chǐ zuò fǎ gōng zhōng cháo sì yí

en: He swore to wipe away the shame of his imperial ancestors, sitting in the palace to receive tribute from the four barbarian tribes.

t: 淮西有賊五十載，封狼生貙貙生羆。
c: 淮西有贼五十载，封狼生貙貙生羆。
p: Huái xī yǒu zéi wǔ shí zǎi fēng láng shēng chū chū shēng pí

en: In Huaixi, rebels have entrenched themselves for fifty years; like a giant wolf birthing a jackal, and the jackal birthing a bear.

t: 不據山河據平地，長戈利矛日可麾。
c: 不据山河据平地，长戈利矛日可麾。
p: Bù jù shān hé jù píng dì cháng gē lì máo rì kě huī
z: ㄅㄨˋ ㄐㄩˋ ㄕㄢ ㄏㄜˊ ㄐㄩˋ ㄆㄧㄥˊ ㄉㄧˋ ㄔㄤˊ ㄍㄜ ㄌㄧˋ ㄇㄠˊ ㄖˋ ㄎㄜˇ ㄏㄨㄟ
en: They do not occupy mountains or rivers but hold the flatlands; with long halberds and sharp spears, they can be commanded daily.

t: 帝得聖相相曰度，賊檻不驚人恬嬉。
c: 帝得圣相相曰度，贼槛不惊人恬嬉。
p: Dì dé shèng xiàng xiàng yuē dù zéi kǎn bù jīng rén tián xī

en: The Emperor found a sage minister named Du; the rebels were caged without causing alarm, and the people remained peaceful and happy.

t: 殺氣三時作陣雲，寒聲一夜傳刁斗。
c: 杀气三时作阵云，寒声一夜传刁斗。
p: Shā qì sān shí zuò zhèn yún hán shēng yī yè chuán diāo dǒu
z: ㄕㄚ ㄑㄧˋ ㄙㄢ ㄕˊ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄓㄣˋ ㄩㄣˊ ㄏㄢˊ ㄕㄥ ㄧ ㄧㄝˋ ㄔㄨㄢˊ ㄉㄧㄠ ㄉㄡˇ
en: The murderous aura forms battle clouds throughout the seasons; the cold sound of watchman's clappers transmits all night long.

wg.en: three seasons (morning, noon, evening / or seasons of farming)
copper cooking pot used as a watchman's clapper at night

t: 相看白刃血紛紛，死節從來豈顧勳。
c: 相看白刃血纷纷，死节从来岂顾勋。
p: Xiāng kàn bái rèn xuè fēn fēn sǐ jié cóng lái qǐ gù xūn

en: We look at each other amidst naked blades and flying blood; dying for honor, who has ever cared about merit or reward?

t: 君不見沙場征戰苦，至今猶憶李將軍。
c: 君不见沙场征战苦，至今犹忆李将军。
p: Jūn bù jiàn shā chǎng zhēng zhàn kǔ zhì jīn yóu yì lǐ jiāng jūn
z: ㄐㄩㄣ ㄅㄨˋ ㄐㄧㄢˋ ㄕㄚ ㄔㄤˇ ㄓㄥ ㄓㄢˋ ㄎㄨˇ ㄓˋ ㄐㄧㄣ ㄧㄡˊ ㄧˋ ㄌㄧˇ ㄐㄧㄤ ㄐㄩㄣ
en: Do you not see the suffering of war on the battlefield? To this day, we still remember General Li.

t: 孺子下馬捧針，立馬碑前神色沮。
c: 孺子下马捧针，立马碑前神色沮。
p: Rú zǐ xià mǎ pěng zhēn lì mǎ bēi qián shén sè jǔ

en: The young lad dismounts holding a needle, standing before the monument with a dejected expression.

t: 公之斯文若元氣，先時已入人肝脾。
c: 公之斯文若元气，先时已入人肝脾。
p: Gōng zhī sī wén ruò yuán qì xiān shí yǐ rù rén gān pí
z: ㄍㄨㄥ ㄓ ㄙ ㄨㄣˊ ㄖㄨㄛˋ ㄩㄢˊ ㄑㄧˋ ㄒㄧㄢ ㄕˊ ㄧˇ ㄖㄨˋ ㄖㄣˊ ㄍㄢ ㄆㄧˊ
en: Your writing is like the primal vital energy; it has long since entered deep into people's hearts.

wg.en: liver and spleen (metaphor for deep inside the body/mind)

t: 湯盤孔鼎有述作，今無其器存其辭。
c: 汤盘孔鼎有述作，今无其器存其辞。
p: Tāng pán kǒng dǐng yǒu shù zuò jīn wú qí qì cún qí cí

en: The Basin of Tang and the Tripod of Confucius had inscriptions; today the vessels are gone, but their words remain.

t: 嗚呼聖皇及聖相，相與赫赫流淳熙。
c: 呜呼圣皇及圣相，相与赫赫流淳熙。
p: Wū hū shèng huáng jí shèng xiàng xiāng yǔ hè hè liú chún xī

en: Alas! The sage Emperor and the sage Minister; together they shine majestically, flowing with pure harmony.

t: 公之斯文不示後，曷與三五相攀追。
c: 公之斯文不示后，曷与三五相攀追。
p: Gōng zhī sī wén bù shì hòu hé yǔ sān wǔ xiāng pān zhuī
z: ㄍㄨㄥ ㄓ ㄙ ㄨㄣˊ ㄅㄨˋ ㄕˋ ㄏㄡˋ ㄏㄜˊ ㄩˇ ㄙㄢ ㄨˇ ㄒㄧㄤ ㄆㄢ ㄓㄨㄟ
en: If your writing is not shown to posterity, how can we aspire to catch up with the Three Kings and Five Emperors?
